_note: One source for weather/atmosphere: image phrase (ChatGPT), motion phrase (Kling), light logic, and the local fx recipe (forge.py fx). Edit here, never in two places.

rain.image: steady rain falling at a slight diagonal, wet reflective asphalt with mirror-like puddles, droplets beading on surfaces, rim light catching the rain streaks
rain.video: rain falls continuously at a slight diagonal, droplets splash in the puddles, wet surfaces shimmer as light moves across them
rain.light: backlight or side-light the rain; front-lit rain is invisible. Wet ground doubles every light source as a reflection.

storm.image: violent thunderstorm, heavy wind-driven rain, a fork of lightning splitting a bruised purple-grey sky, the scene lit cold blue for an instant
storm.video: heavy rain whips sideways in gusts, a lightning flash briefly lights the whole scene, clothes and hair are pushed by the wind
storm.light: the lightning is the key light for one frame; everything else stays dark and cold.

drizzle.image: fine drizzle hanging in the air like a soft veil, damp glistening surfaces, muted overcast light
drizzle.video: a fine drizzle drifts slowly through the frame, tiny droplets catch the light
drizzle.light: soft overcast, low contrast; let a single warm practical light break the grey.

snow.image: large soft snowflakes drifting down, fresh snow settling on shoulders and rooftops, breath visible as vapor, cold blue shadows with warm window light
snow.video: snowflakes drift down slowly and sway in a light wind, breath vapor rises from the subject
snow.light: snow is a giant reflector: shadows go blue, faces get a soft fill from below.

blizzard.image: whiteout blizzard, dense snow driven horizontally by the wind, visibility collapsing into white, figures reduced to dark silhouettes
blizzard.video: dense snow streams sideways across the frame in strong gusts, the background disappears into white
blizzard.light: flat and directionless; separate the subject by silhouette and a single warm lantern.

fog.image: thick low-lying fog swallowing the background, layers of depth fading into grey, silhouettes emerging from the mist, volumetric light beams cutting through
fog.video: fog rolls slowly across the ground and drifts between the layers of the scene
fog.light: backlight into fog = visible beams. Keep the subject one layer in front of the densest fog.

mist.image: a soft morning mist over the landscape, aerial perspective with each distant layer lighter and bluer, dew on the grass
mist.video: a thin mist drifts gently over the ground as the morning light grows
mist.light: low sun, long soft shadows, haze lifts the blacks.

haze.image: warm atmospheric haze, the air thick with light, distant buildings softened and lifted, a glowing halo around the sun
haze.video: the hazy air glows as the sun slowly drops behind the skyline
haze.light: lifted blacks, low contrast, halation around highlights.

sandstorm.image: an orange-brown sandstorm, airborne sand turning the sun into a pale disc, fabric whipping in the wind, grains streaking across the frame
sandstorm.video: sand streams sideways in strong gusts, scarves and robes snap in the wind, the sun dims behind the dust
sandstorm.light: everything turns amber; contrast collapses with distance.

dust.image: dust motes floating in a shaft of sunlight through a window, the beam clearly visible, the rest of the room in soft shadow
dust.video: dust particles drift slowly through the beam of light
dust.light: one hard source through a gap, dark background behind the beam.

godrays.image: crepuscular god rays streaming through the gaps between clouds or trees, visible volumetric light shafts, deep shadows between the beams
godrays.video: light shafts slowly sweep across the scene as the clouds move
godrays.light: needs atmosphere (haze, dust, fog) plus a strong backlight partly blocked.

golden_hour.image: golden hour, low warm sun grazing the scene, long shadows, glowing rim light on hair and skin, a gentle lens flare
golden_hour.video: the low sun flickers through moving leaves, warm light glides across the subject
golden_hour.light: sun 5-10 degrees above the horizon, behind or beside the subject.

blue_hour.image: blue hour just after sunset, deep cobalt sky, city lights and windows switching on in warm tungsten, balanced sky and artificial light
blue_hour.video: the sky deepens to cobalt while the city lights flicker on one by one
blue_hour.light: cool ambient vs warm practicals: the classic complementary split.

neon_rain_night.image: rain-soaked city street at night, neon signs in magenta and cyan reflected in wet pavement, steam rising from a grate, light rain falling
neon_rain_night.video: rain falls through the neon glow, reflections ripple in the puddles, steam drifts upward
neon_rain_night.light: colored practicals only; keep skin readable with a soft key from a sign.

smoke.image: swirling smoke curling through the beam of a hard light, layered translucent wisps, dark background
smoke.video: smoke curls and drifts slowly upward, catching the light
smoke.light: backlight or side-light the smoke against black.

embers.image: glowing orange embers and sparks rising into the night air, warm firelight flickering on faces, smoke above
embers.video: embers rise and swirl upward on the heat, firelight flickers across the faces
embers.light: a low warm source, flickering; everything else falls into darkness.

heat_haze.image: shimmering heat haze above the asphalt, a mirage on the horizon, bleached harsh midday sun
heat_haze.video: heat haze ripples and shimmers above the ground, distant shapes waver
heat_haze.light: high hard sun, short shadows, washed-out sky.

aurora.image: green and violet aurora borealis rippling across a starry sky above a snowy landscape, reflected in a still lake
aurora.video: the aurora ripples and shifts slowly across the sky
aurora.light: very low light; long-exposure look with crisp stars.

underwater.image: underwater, rippling caustic light patterns dancing on the sand and the subject, suspended particles, light rays from the surface fading into deep blue
underwater.video: caustic light ripples across the subject, small particles float past, hair drifts weightlessly
underwater.light: light comes only from above; color shifts to cyan with depth.

steam.image: steam rising in soft curls, backlit and glowing, droplets of condensation
steam.video: steam rises and curls slowly, catching the backlight
steam.light: backlight is mandatory or steam disappears.

wind_leaves.image: autumn leaves caught mid-air in a gust of wind, hair and coat blown sideways, motion in the trees
wind_leaves.video: a gust of wind sweeps through, leaves swirl across the frame, hair and clothes flutter
wind_leaves.light: dappled light through moving branches adds life.
